sentences.text: Abul Hossain Molla vs Unknown on 3 February, 2026
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh 03.02.2026

In re : An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of  Criminal Procedure, 1973/under Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 in  connection with SPL ST No. 34 of 2023 corresponding to SC  No. 14 of 2023 arising out of Kultali PS Case No. 66 of 2023  dt. 29.01.2023 u/s 363/365/376(3) of the IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
 -And-

In the matter of : Abul Hossain Molla  ... Petitioner(
 Mr. Apalak Basu  Mr. Nazir Ahmed  Ms. Sanghamitra Mridha  ... for the Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Antarikhya Basu  Mr. Parvej Anam  ... for the State-respondent(s)
Mr. K. K. Ray ... for the defacto-complainant Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for about three years and the victim in her cross-examination answered in such a manner which has hardly any scope for conviction.

Learned advocate for the State produces the Case Diary and draws the attention of the court to the medicolegal examination as well as the statement of the victim at the relevant stage along with the other witnesses.

Considering the medicolegal examination as well as the age of the victim, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail in the background of the facts of the case as it is revealed that the present petitioner at the time of being involved in a sexual relationship with a minor was already married having two children.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Considering the medicolegal examination as well as the age of the victim, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail in the background of the facts of the case as it is revealed that the present petitioner at the time of being involved in a sexual relationship with a minor was already married having two children.
Having regard to the manner in which the offence has been committed, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Hence, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is Rejected.

Accordingly, CRM(M) 99 of 2026 is dismissed.
Pending application(s), if any, is also disposed of.
